metadata.description: AI-powered resume builder — PDF import, multi-theme/multi-language editing, HTML and PDF export

plugins.name: resume-builder
plugins.description: Build, edit, and format professional resumes with PDF import, HTML/PDF export, multi-language output, and style customization. Use when users need to create a new resume, import and modify an existing PDF resume, add/update education, work experience, or projects, export to styled HTML or PDF formats, generate multi-language versions, or apply professional styling and formatting to resume content.
